aboutPage.heading: Built for how Yerevan actually lives
aboutPage.intro: We didn't set out to build another gym. We set out to build the one place in Yerevan where training, recovering, eating well, and bringing your family could all happen without getting back in the car.

story.title: Why we started
story.text: Yerevan has great gyms, great pools, great spas — scattered across the city, each requiring its own trip, its own membership, its own schedule. We asked what it would take to put all of it under one roof, done well, and built from there.

story.title: What we built
story.text: Eight zones on one site: a full gym floor, indoor and outdoor pools, group studios, a spa, a beauty salon and barbershop, two restaurants, and dedicated clubs for kids and expecting mothers — plus parking and a car wash, so the whole visit takes care of itself.

story.title: Who it's for
story.text: Early risers who want a swim before work. Parents who need somewhere for the kids while they train. Anyone who wants a proper spa day without leaving the building they just worked out in. We built for all of it at once.

pillars.title: Movement
pillars.text: A full gym floor, group studios, and two pools mean there's always a way to train, whatever the day calls for.

pillars.title: Recovery
pillars.text: Sauna, massage, and spa treatments are steps away from the gym floor, not a separate trip across town.

pillars.title: Community
pillars.text: Group classes, a kids' club, and a dedicated space for expecting mothers make this a place for the whole family, not just the individual member.

pillars.title: Convenience
pillars.text: Restaurants, a beauty salon, barbershop, parking, and a car wash mean one visit can cover most of your day.

timeline.text: Groundbreaking on the largest wellness site in the city.
Construction and equipment installation across all eight zones, from the pools to the spa.
Doors opened on July 31 — memberships, classes, and the full facility went live.

faq.question: How do membership terms work?
faq.answer: Plans run from 2 to 12 months. Longer terms include better value and more flexibility on freezing your membership.

faq.question: Can I freeze my membership?
faq.answer: Standard and Premium plans include a freeze option, so travel or injury doesn't cost you time you've paid for.

faq.question: What comes with a guest pass?
faq.answer: Standard and Premium members get a monthly guest pass — bring a friend or family member in for a full visit, no separate membership needed.

faq.question: Is there a kids' or family option?
faq.answer: The kids' club and pregnancy club are included in every plan — there's no separate membership needed for either.

faq.question: How do I find out pricing?
faq.answer: Message us on Instagram or ask at the front desk — we'll walk you through current pricing and get you set up.

careers.text: We're building a team as big as the center itself — trainers, therapists, and hosts who make Yerevan Wellness feel like home. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.
